facts.big: I do not eat… · Without…, please
facts.label: Pedir sem carne
facts.sub: Diga o que não come com I do not eat meat. Pergunte Does the pasta have meat? e peça com Without cheese, please. Para tirar algo, use No onions, please.

facts.label: Vegetariano
facts.sub: Muitos cardápios dos EUA marcam pratos vegetarianos com um V ou uma folha. Vegetarianos não comem carne, nem frango, nem peixe, mas podem comer ovos e queijo.

facts.label: Vegano
facts.sub: Veganos não comem nenhum produto animal, nem leite, ovos ou mel. Muitos restaurantes têm uma opção vegana, e os servidores explicam o que cada prato leva.

mini.en: Perfect. I take the pasta without {cheese|onions|meat}, please.
mini.pt: Perfeito. Quero a massa sem {queijo|cebola|carne}, por favor.

compare.br: In Brazil, restaurantes also have pratos vegetarianos, and people often ask “sem carne”.
compare.us: In the USA, vegetarian options are very common, and menus often mark them with a V.

pages.title: Pasta without cheese · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday evening in a small restaurant in Seattle. Soft lights shine on the wooden tables. Dev sits near the window and opens the menu. He is hungry, but he does not eat meat. Lia, the server, comes with a notebook. She smiles and asks if he is ready.
“Welcome! Are you ready to order?” says Lia. “Yes. I do not eat meat.” says Dev. “No problem. We have pasta and soup.” says Lia.
